documents.title: Last Will and Testament of Katrina Tan Wei Lin
documents.notes: Executed on 22 August 2023. Witnessed by Ng Mei Ling (neighbour, Blk 248 Toa Payoh Lorong 1 #05-456) and Ahmad bin Ibrahim (colleague, 22 Lorong 8 Toa Payoh #10-234). 3 pages, each signed by testatrix and both witnesses. Pursuant to Wills Act (Cap 352).

clauses.title: Revocation

clauses.content: 3.1: HDB flat to Daniel. 3.2: jade bangle to niece Rachel. 3.3: SGD $10,000 to Community Chest.
